description: This file defines a custom handler class 'KilocodeOpenrouterHandler' that extends 'OpenRouterHandler' to interact with the KiloCode OpenRouter API, including model fetching, request customization, and streaming responses.

classes.name: KilocodeOpenrouterHandler
classes.description: A custom handler class for interacting with KiloCode's OpenRouter API, providing model management, request customization, and streaming capabilities.

methods.name: getRolloutHash
methods.description: Generates a hash based on the kilocode token for rollout identification.

methods.name: customRequestOptions
methods.description: Creates custom request headers based on metadata and options.

methods.name: getTotalCost
methods.description: Calculates total usage cost based on last usage data.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model configuration, considering specific provider endpoints.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches models, endpoints, and default model info from the API.

methods.name: fimSupport
methods.description: Checks if FIM (Fine-tuned Inference Model) support is available for the current model.

methods.name: streamFim
methods.description: Streams FIM completions from the API, yielding content chunks.
